scientific_integrity: All-parameter analytic derivation using the rank-one Daugavet identity, an attained sharp paired-point Lipschitz envelope, uniqueness through saturation, and Taylor expansions; 4,971 auxiliary finite numerical assertions only supplement the proof.
scientific_limitations: Real C([0,1]); symmetric signed-power integrable densities, exponent alpha>-1; Lipschitz bound on the uniquely normalized projection coefficient; asymptotics at fixed alpha. No generalization to asymmetric sign profiles or other Daugavet spaces is proved. Independent mathematical validation and global publication-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Sharp Lipschitz-budget rigidity for nonattaining hyperplane projections
